lines.en: My four legs have not all grown in yet.

lines.zh: 再吃几顿，我就走得比马快。
lines.en: A few more meals and I outpace a horse.
My belly is heavy, but my steps are light.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看哪里有肉。
lines.en: I walk while scanning for meat.

lines.zh: 骨头在长，走起来咯吱响。
lines.en: My bones are growing and creak as I walk.

lines.zh: 这条腿是新的，还不太听话。
lines.en: This leg is new and does not obey yet.
The grass flattens where I tread.
I can carry you now; believe it.
The bigger I get, the deeper I breathe.

lines.zh: 我的影子今天又长了一截。
lines.en: My shadow grew another handspan today.
Do not rush; I am still growing.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬得动，前腿还想睡。
lines.en: My hind legs push; my forelegs still want sleep.

lines.zh: 我能闻出三里外的血肉。
lines.en: I can smell flesh three li away.
Follow me; there are rabbits in the grass.

lines.zh: 我趴着，让肚子贴着暖地。
lines.en: I lie with my belly against warm ground.
I am counting how many teeth I have.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我连尾巴都懒得甩。
lines.en: Well fed, I cannot be bothered to flick my tail.

lines.zh: 这块石头硌着我的肋骨。
lines.en: This stone is pressing into my ribs.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的爪子发呆。
lines.en: I stare blankly at my own claws.
I grew too fast, and my hide feels tight.
I am listening to the noise in my belly.

lines.zh: 要是现在有块生肉就好了。
lines.en: If only there were raw meat right now.

lines.zh: 我舔自己的伤口，它快好了。
lines.en: I lick my own wound; it is nearly healed.

lines.zh: 尾巴自己摇，我没让它摇。
lines.en: My tail wags on its own, without my asking.

lines.zh: 我打盹时还留着一只耳朵。
lines.en: Even dozing, I keep one ear up.
This body looks different every day.

lines.zh: 我在试能不能够到自己的背。
lines.en: I am testing whether I can reach my own back.

lines.zh: 安静下来，我听见骨头在长。
lines.en: In the quiet, I hear my bones growing.

lines.zh: 我换了个姿势，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I shift position and a bone clicks.

lines.zh: 我盯着主人的手，等它动。
lines.en: I watch my master's hand and wait for it to move.
There is meat smell in your sleeve.
Let me see if you are worth carrying.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，我又不咬主人。
lines.en: Do not shake; I do not bite my master.
Your shoulders are broad; I can bear you.
I am measuring your waist with my eyes.

lines.zh: 你身上有金苹果的味道吗。
lines.en: Do you smell of golden apples?

lines.zh: 抬头，我看看你带了什么。
lines.en: Look up; let me see what you brought.
You have lost weight since our last meeting.

lines.zh: 我看的是你手里那块肉。
lines.en: I am watching the meat in your hand.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候像块肉在动。
lines.en: When you smile, you look like moving meat.

lines.zh: 主人的眼睛，我记得很清楚。
lines.en: I remember the eyes of my master very well.
To ride me, first fill my belly.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在猜你的重量。
lines.en: I tilt my head to guess your weight.
Do not put your hand so near; I am tempted.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在我的旧疤上。
lines.en: That blade found my old scar.
The pain made me shrink back a step.
Thick hide or not, the blade found flesh.
Not the belly; there are no bones there.
I roar because it truly hurts.
The wound is growing closed; soon it is fine.
Half my tusk is left in your armor.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被拼起来时。
lines.en: This recalls the day I was pieced together.

lines.zh: 我流血流得很快，饿得更快。
lines.en: I bleed fast and get hungry faster.

lines.zh: 疼完这一阵，我还要吃肉。
lines.en: Once the pain passes, I still want meat.
Meat! Even a small piece will do.
Raw meat smells better than cooked; do not boil it.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，我能长一圈。
lines.en: One bite and I gain a whole ring of size.

lines.zh: 你手一抖，我就扑上去了。
lines.en: If your hand shakes, I will pounce.
Save the golden apple; meat first.
I am hungry enough to chew bone.

lines.zh: 别逗我，我咬人没轻没重。
lines.en: Do not tease me; my bite has no measure.

lines.zh: 肉进了嘴，我的腿就更有劲。
lines.en: Meat in my mouth makes my legs stronger.
A full belly buys my loyalty.
That piece of meat is moving; I want it.
Bump me and you will bounce off.
I am still growing; do not squeeze my ribs.
You stepped on my claw; back off.
This bulk of mine is not soft.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我肚子晃了三晃。
lines.en: One bump and my belly wobbled three times.

lines.zh: 我这体型，走路本来就占地方。
lines.en: At my size, I take up room just walking.
Do not push my belly; it is stuffed full.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我獠牙上了。
lines.en: Your shoulder met my tusk.
Step back; this frame of mine is turning.
After that knock, I need another meal.
I am not grown enough to think of that.

lines.zh: 喂我金苹果，会分出一只山羊。
lines.en: Feed me a golden apple and a goat splits off.

lines.zh: 那不是伴，那是另一半的我。
lines.en: That is no mate; it is the other half of me.
First I grow up, then we talk.

lines.zh: 奇美拉自己就能一分为二。
lines.en: A chimera can divide itself in two.

lines.zh: 山羊使魔出来时，别吓着它。
lines.en: When the goat comes out, do not frighten it.
This body of mine is pieced together.
You may as well cut grass as ask me that.
First meat, then everything after.

lines.zh: 等分出山羊，你就多一个伙伴。
lines.en: When the goat splits off, you gain another companion.
Meat on the ground belongs to me.
I take it in my mouth without dirtying it.
This will add half an inch to me.
I catch it with my teeth, quite steadily.
Do not race me; my teeth are quicker.
I will carry it back and bury it by my den.
This thing can feed me.
My mouth is full; I will set it here.
I want the bone too, for my teeth.
Toss it higher; I catch with my mouth.
That one is fat enough; I have chosen it.
Its legs are short; it cannot outrun me.
I see its throat pulsing.
Bite the hind leg first and it goes down.

lines.zh: 我这体型，现在能扑倒它。
lines.en: At this size, I can bring it down.
It walked into my ground.
Do not shout; the prey will hear.
So small; one gulp finishes it.
It fears me, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 风从它那边吹来，我闻到了。
lines.en: The wind comes from it; I smell it.
Belly to the dirt, my hind legs coil.
This time, I am the hunter.
It turned its back on me; bad luck.
I have marked it; it will not escape.
My hind legs are digging in; wait a moment.

lines.zh: 我数着它的步子，找空档。
lines.en: I count its steps and look for the gap.

lines.zh: 牙已经露出来了，别站前面。
lines.en: My teeth are showing; do not stand in front.
I fix on the neck; that is softest.
Two more steps and it is within reach.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在替我数拍子。
lines.en: My tail is keeping time for me.
When its neck shifts, I pounce.

lines.zh: 这口气憋着，等扑出去再吐。
lines.en: I hold this breath until the leap.
Do not pull me back; I am about to pounce.

lines.zh: 地面有点滑，我换个角度。
lines.en: The ground is slick; I change my angle.
It backs to the wall; no way out.

lines.zh: 我看见它的肌肉绷起来了。
lines.en: I see its muscles tighten.
Nearly in reach; keep quiet and still.
I count down: three, two, one.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，我先绕到侧后。
lines.en: It has not seen me, so I circle to its flank.
One bite, and the blood is hot.

lines.zh: 我把它按在地上，爪子先动。
lines.en: I pin it down and my claws go first.
My tusk is stuck in the bone.

lines.zh: 獠牙磨了三个月，就为这口。
lines.en: Three months of whetting for this bite.
It screams loudly; I do not let go.
I bite and shake, tearing it like cloth.
Foreclaws hold; hind legs kick.
The bigger I am, the deeper I bite.
After this fight, I will be hungry again.
Stay back; I have not let go.

lines.zh: 我从召唤阵里挤出半个身子。
lines.en: I squeeze half my body out of the circle.
Being this hungry right after arriving is normal.
I smudged the chalk lines.
I came out a bit bigger than last time.
Where is my master? I want food.

lines.zh: 空气里有墨和铁的味道。
lines.en: The air smells of ink and iron.
My four legs are not steady yet.

lines.zh: 契约一亮，我就有了骨头。
lines.en: The pact glows, and I have bones.

lines.zh: 刚拼好的骨头还松着呢。
lines.en: The bones just pieced together are still loose.

lines.zh: 我记得这个屋子的地板。
lines.en: I remember this floor.

lines.zh: 我又被从黑暗里拽出来。
lines.en: I have been dragged out of the dark again.

lines.zh: 先给我一块肉当见面礼。
lines.en: Give me meat as a greeting gift.

lines.zh: 长大了，连召唤阵都嫌小。
lines.en: Grown this big, even the circle feels small.
Teeth grow out of the ink for me.

lines.zh: 阵法还没散，我就尝到铁味。
lines.en: The circle is still glowing and I taste iron.

lines.zh: 我又大了一圈，门槛快过不去。
lines.en: I grew again; soon I will not fit the doorway.
Burnt fur smells truly awful.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，骨头都震了。
lines.en: I fell from height and all my bones rang.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我讨厌这个。
lines.en: Water up my nose; I hate this.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻了个跟头。
lines.en: The blast tumbled me like a dropped sack.
An arrow is stuck in my back, and it itches.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的骨头错位了。
lines.en: Magic knocked my bones out of line.

lines.zh: 饿得我开始啃自己的爪。
lines.en: I am hungry enough to chew my own paw.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，四条腿都软了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and all four legs went weak.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，我踩空了。
lines.en: There is no ground here, and I stepped into nothing.
